places.name: Ashford
places.desc: The Drowned Lantern, Brannoc, the Lantern Board of side quests, and the road out of town.

places.name: The Old Mine
places.desc: Where Edric said "they’re digging for it." Cult diggers at the mouth, and Ammarindar halls below.

places.name: Goblin Warren
places.desc: Grisk Two-Teeth holds the missing miners. Fight, sneak, or trade food.

places.name: Varrow’s Mill
places.desc: Abandoned since the Varrows were driven out. Shadows move like a family at a dinner table.

places.name: Steaming Cave
places.desc: Scorched goats and melted snow. Wix refuses to go any closer. Something small and red has hatched here.

places.name: Abbey of the Morninglord
places.desc: A ruined abbey of Lathander on the marsh edge. The second shard lies in its undercroft.

places.name: Drowned Marrowmere
places.desc: A bog village where the warm water has woken the dead. Don’t go in at night.

places.name: Lizardfolk grounds
places.desc: Territorial hunters. They respect gifts and plain speaking.

places.name: Mother Sallow’s hut
places.desc: A kindly old woman lives here, they say. Her reflection disagrees.

places.name: Ashfall Pass
places.desc: The road into the high Greypeaks.

places.name: The King’s Kiln
places.desc: King Varrow’s tomb in an old dwarven forge-hall.

places.name: Wix’s clan caves
places.desc: Wix’s family, and a hill giant problem.
